description.text: (1) Program Category Chinese Language Student Program:This program offers multiple-level Chinese learning from A to F to meet the needs of international students from elementary level (A, B), intermediate level (C, D) to advanced level (E, F). This program will improve students’ communication ability of comprehensive Chinese language from listening, speaking, reading and writing. (2) Main courses： Chinese Language Student Program:Comprehensive Chinese, Chinese Listening, Oral Chinese, Chinese Reading, Chinese Writing, etc.

duration.text: The Chinese Language Student Program at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) Passport (2) Academic Certificate: official certificate of your highest education or the official document of enrollment issued by the current institution. (3) Transcripts (4) Physical Examination Form (please download the attached file below). Overseas applications can replace this document with a personal commitment letter (please download the attached file below), and provide official document before entering China. Applicants in China can upload personal health certificate or residence permit instead. (5) Certificate of Non-criminal Record. A certificate issued by the police station or law enforcement agency certifying that you have no previous criminal record. Overseas applications can replace this document with a personal commitment letter (please download the attached file below), and provide official document before entering China. (6) Financial Certification/Bank Statement, 5000 USD or above (No need for International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship students). (7) Applicants under the age of 18 shall provide certified documents of designation signed by their entrusted legal guardians in China. Note: All application documents must be in Chinese or English edition. Documents issued in the third language should be translated in Chinese or English editions.

requirements.text: Applicants must hold a valid foreign passport and have graduated from high school (high school graduates can provide a pre-graduation certificate during application, and provide graduation certificate before registration); Foreign citizens, in good physical and mental health, and with good academic performance.
